intro.title: One address. Two reasons to choose it.
intro.text: Most mountain holidays make you choose: a good place to sleep or a good place to eat. Here you don't have to. Go up to your apartment, come down for dinner. Same people, same standard, from check-in to the last pizza.

stay.title: Six apartments. Zero compromises.
stay.text: Every apartment is independent, with a fully equipped kitchen, living area and private bathroom. Real space for couples, families and groups of friends, with the freedom of a home and a restaurant right downstairs.

dine.title: Real Trentino cooking. Master-made pizza.
dine.text: Lunch and dinner built on the traditional recipes of Val di Sole and ingredients from our valleys. In the evening, pizza by our master pizzaiolo. Open to everyone, not just our guests.

exp.title: Val di Sole, right outside the door.
exp.text: In winter, ski Folgarida-Marilleva and Madonna di Campiglio. In summer, the cycle path, rafting on the Noce and the trails of two nature parks. You plan the day, we take care of the evening.

where.title: In the heart of Val di Sole.
where.text: We are in Dimaro Folgarida, minutes from the Folgarida-Marilleva lifts and right on the Val di Sole cycle path. Madonna di Campiglio and the Tonale Pass are within easy reach.

final.title: The best dates go first.
final.text: Send us your dates and we'll reply with availability and price. The request is not binding.

meta.title: Restaurant & Pizzeria in Dimaro Folgarida, Val di Sole | Locanda dei Gemelli
meta.description: A modern osteria in Val di Sole: Trentino cooking with local ingredients and pizza by our master pizzaiolo. Lunch and dinner in Dimaro Folgarida, closed on Tuesdays.

hero.title: Real Trentino cooking. Master-made pizza. No shortcuts.
hero.lead: The modern osteria of Val di Sole: ingredients from our valleys, traditional local recipes and a pizza worth the trip. Open to everyone, for lunch and dinner.

manifesto.title: If we wouldn't serve it to our own family, it doesn't reach your table.
manifesto.text: A restaurant isn't judged by its furniture. It's judged by the plate. That's why we start with the produce: mountain ingredients that are seasonal and traceable, chosen from producers in our valleys. Then we treat them with respect, using the traditional recipes of Val di Sole and Trentino and today's technique.

pillars.title: Roots
pillars.text: The recipes we grew up with, from the traditions of Val di Sole and Trentino. Every dish starts there.

pillars.title: Season
pillars.text: The menu follows the mountain. We use what the valleys give at that moment, at its best.

pillars.title: Craft
pillars.text: Modern technique in service of flavour, not effect. Nothing superfluous on the plate.

kitchen.title: Tradition, done today.
kitchen.text: Trentino dishes reinterpreted with a modern touch, plus a few international options for those who want to leave the beaten path. Fresh ingredients, honest portions, clear flavours. The lunch you need between runs and the dinner you remember at the end of your holiday.
kitchen.menu: The full menu will soon be available on this page.

pizza.title: Pizza is a craft. Our master knows it.
pizza.text: Every pizza comes from the hands of our master pizzaiolo. Carefully made dough, quality seasonal toppings, considered pairings. You'll find the classics you love and special combinations born in our kitchen that you won't find anywhere else.

services.title: The same standard, wherever you want to eat.

items.title: Takeaway and home delivery
items.text: Our cooking and our pizza, at your home or in your holiday apartment. Same care, same taste.

items.title: Garden and events
items.text: Summer evenings outdoors, birthdays, group dinners and parties. The garden is ready for your event.

items.title: Business lunches and meetings
items.text: A private room, presentation equipment, coffee breaks, buffet or light lunch. You focus on the meeting, we handle the rest.

restaurant.quote: The valleys provide the ingredients. We bring the craft.

book.title: Your table is waiting.
book.text: Soon you'll be able to book online with TheFork or message us on WhatsApp. In the meantime, we look forward to welcoming you at Via Campiglio 59.

meta.title: Things to do in Val di Sole, winter and summer | Locanda dei Gemelli
meta.description: Skiing at Folgarida-Marilleva and Madonna di Campiglio, the Val di Sole cycle path, rafting on the Noce, hiking in the parks. All minutes from Locanda dei Gemelli.

hero.title: Two seasons. A valley that never stops.
hero.lead: Dimaro Folgarida is the ideal starting point: slopes in winter, rivers and trails in summer. You choose the day, we take care of the evening.

items.title: Folgarida-Marilleva
items.text: The lifts are minutes from the Locanda. From here you can ski all the way to Madonna di Campiglio in the Skiarea Campiglio Dolomiti di Brenta.

items.title: Tonale Pass
items.text: High-altitude slopes and the Presena glacier, for reliable snow all season long.

items.title: Cross-country and snowshoeing
items.text: Cross-country loops and snowshoe trails through the valley's woods, for those who prefer silence to speed.

items.title: Val di Sole cycle path
items.text: The cycle path runs through Dimaro and follows the Noce river along the valley. Perfect for families, e-bikes included.

items.title: Rafting on the Noce
items.text: The Noce is one of Europe's best-loved rivers for rafting and kayaking, with routes for beginners and experts.

items.title: Hiking in the parks
items.text: Stelvio National Park and Adamello Brenta Nature Park: trails, mountain huts and alpine lakes for every level.

base.title: The day is yours. The evening is ours.
base.text: Back from the slopes or the trail, go up to your apartment and come down for dinner. No car to take, no table to hunt for.
